facts.intro_first_150_words: After 30 years at Schneider Electric across five countries and several different parts of our business I believe the next decade could be one of the most exciting I have experienced AI is driving extraordinary demand for digital infrastructure with data centers we once considered large at 20 or 30MW being dwarfed by 500MW developments and even gigawatt-scale campuses But scale is only part of the story AI is changing how infrastructure is designed where it can be built how quickly it needs to be delivered and what customers expect from their partners As I take on the leadership of our Secure Power and Data Center business in Europe three areas stand out to me In the AI era speed wins I spent 20 years of my career in supply chain Today I believe supply chain has become one of the most important competitive differentiators in the data center industry
